entities.name: Gordan Firić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gordan Firić is a Bosnian former professional basketball player. He played as a shooting guard and was also a member of the Bosnia and Herzegovina national basketball team. He is currently an assistant coach for the Bosnian national team.
